summary: Complete testing of SaaS Billing Refactor: simplified pricing model (monthly_price + per_invoice_price, no tenure selector, GST inclusive). All 27 backend tests passed. All frontend UI checks passed. Full E2E verification of the new billing model.

minor.issue: Response still includes legacy fields saas_plan_type, per_customer_rate, monthly_base_fee (lines 690-692 in operator.py). These are harmless dead fields (no plan has these columns) but unnecessary code debt.

action_items: MINOR: Clean up legacy fields in operator.py subscription endpoint (lines 690-692): saas_plan_type, per_customer_rate, monthly_base_fee are no longer relevant fields.
critical_code_review_comments: operator.py lines 690-692: subscription endpoint returns 3 stale legacy fields (saas_plan_type, per_customer_rate, monthly_base_fee). These have no functional impact since the frontend doesn't use them, but should be removed for cleanliness.
All new billing fields are correctly implemented: monthly_price (GST inclusive), per_invoice_price, fixed 1-month term. No GST calculation on top. Checkout correctly sets gst_amount=0.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_UI_Plan_1499 (monthly_price=1499, per_invoice_price=8) via admin UI and TEST_Billing_Refactor_Plan via backend test. Both cleaned up. DB restored to Basic Plan + Pro Plan only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Billing refactor fully tested and working. DB has 2 plans: Basic Plan (₹999/mo, ₹10/invoice) and Pro Plan (₹2999/mo, ₹5/invoice). Operator1 is on trial status (expires 21 Mar 2026). Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_billing_refactor.py (27 tests). All new billing model features verified: no tenure selector, GST inclusive pricing, wallet top-up tab, correct plan display with monthly_price.
